goal: Every real search is captured reliably, administrator tests are visible without contaminating public demand, and the management system provides a complete operational path from demand to an editable publishable page.

Responsive transitions are release-critical state changes
Public mobile screenshots are required release evidence

requirements.statement: Every real search is captured reliably, administrator tests are visible without contaminating public demand, and the management system provides a complete operational path from demand to an editable publishable page.
requirements.acceptance_check: A signed-in administrator search appears under tests within one refresh, public demand is unchanged, and the matching opportunity opens in the editor.

requirements.statement: Predict likely Adir rejection reasons and bind prevention to observable evidence before implementation.
requirements.acceptance_check: The bounded predictive manifest matches the task identity and selected lessons and passes deterministic validation.

requirements.statement: After the ingestion contract and report model pass focused tests, before broad visual expansion.
requirements.acceptance_check: Record observed evidence from the planned midpoint checks before broadening or finishing the affected family.
evidence: Focused integration suite passed 18/18: authenticated no-consent admin tests retain internal mode, non-admin events discard, public totals exclude internal rows, recent public/internal inventories and direct opportunity links are present. TypeScript passed.

requirements.statement: Attempt to disprove completion using the planned rejection questions at the natural destination and across the affected family.
requirements.acceptance_check: Record the attacks performed and the exact natural-destination and affected-family evidence that survived them.

requirements.statement: Measure whether the proactive gate reduced repeated correction work for this task.
requirements.acceptance_check: Record first-pass acceptance state, repeated corrections, prevented failures, and elapsed time or a precise unavailable baseline.

requirements.statement: לפני עבודה מהותית המבצע מתרגם את הבקשה לתוצאה המלאה, חוזה מה אדיר צפוי לבדוק, מאמת אמת והרשאה, ובונה בדיקות קבלה וראיה גלויה במקום שבו התוצאה אמורה לעבוד.
requirements.acceptance_check: A new representative version-two task contract cannot start without a valid matching predictive manifest, rejects a missing or oversized lesson bundle and private feedback storage, creates midpoint, adversarial and effectiveness requirements, detects manifest tampering and blocks completion while any predictive check is pending. A complete real contract must return VERIFIED, while an existing version-one contract must remain finishable.
evidence: Matching validated predictive preflight, version-two task contract, midpoint evidence and validated root-cause manifest exist for this exact task.

requirements.statement: Every responsive website must remain correct through mobile-to-desktop and desktop-to-mobile transitions, reloads, orientation changes and browser device-emulation changes, including while overlays and scroll locks are active.
requirements.acceptance_check: A real public route passes fresh desktop, desktop reload, fresh 390-pixel mobile, mobile overlay open followed by desktop resize, desktop reload, breakpoint boundary, orientation change and return to mobile. At every step the page has meaningful visible content, scrollX is zero, document width does not exceed viewport width and desktop has no stale mobile lock, backdrop or expanded state.

requirements.statement: A mobile search product is not visually approved until meaningful content is visible in the viewport and an independent checker inspects both a public-domain screenshot and the live page. DOM presence, text length, build output and overflow measurements alone are insufficient.
requirements.acceptance_check: A public Spa results route with an artificially empty results control must fail with no-visible-results-state or excessive-empty-band, and the report must contain a screenshot path inspected by the independent checker.

requirements.statement: שום פרויקט או תוצר אינם גמורים כאשר היעד הטבעי אינו מציג את התוצאה המבוקשת, כאשר מצב שנשמר לא שרד רענון, כאשר קיימים רכיבים מתים, מצבים מזויפים, מסלולים קטועים וחיבורים שלא נבדקו מקצה לקצה, או כאשר המבצע לא פתח בעצמו את הגרסה המדויקת ובדק אותה לפי סוג התוצר. לאחר כל תיקון מקומי חוזרים להבטחה המקורית ולמטרת העל, ובודקים מחדש את כל המסלול, משפחת המצבים והקריטריונים הקריטיים. הוכחה שתוקן הפרט האחרון אינה אישור שהמוצר, המסמך, המחקר, המדיה, האוטומציה או הפעולה העסקית המלאה מוכנים או שאדיר צפוי להיות מרוצה. מוצר ציבורי שמשרת לקוחות אינו מאושר למסירה רק על בסיס בדיקות המבצע: לאחר פרסום מועמד מותנה נדרשת קבוצת בדיקות מייצגת על הגרסה המדויקת, עם תרחישי לקוח, תפעול, עסק וסיכון. פרויקט מסוג אחר מפעיל בדיקות בעלי עניין מתאימות לסוגו או מנמק במדויק מדוע השער אינו חל. כל מסירה לאדיר כוללת קישור ישיר ושימושי לכל תוצאה שניתנת לפתיחה. אם אין קישור אפשרי, מציינים זאת במפורש ומוסרים את המיקום המדויק או דרך האחזור.
requirements.acceptance_check: Before any complete, ready or likely-to-satisfy judgment, the evidence must name the original promise, distinguish the latest repaired detail from the full outcome, map every critical journey and affected-family item to passed evidence, a precise blocker or justified exclusion, and inspect the exact final artifact at its natural destination. A fixture that proves only the most recent local correction must be blocked from full approval, regardless of project type. A deliberately incomplete review or task must be blocked. A public customer-facing review must also fail without five to ten passed post-deploy representative actor scenarios on the exact version and at least three applicable stakeholder perspectives. A justified non-public or non-customer artifact must remain valid without an irrelevant public cohort. A completed result with an addressable destination fails delivery when its direct link is omitted. A result without a possible link passes only when the exact location or retrieval path and a concrete no-link reason are present.

requirements.statement: פריסה או שינוי דומיין דורשים גרסה שמורה, כתובת יעד מאומתת, בדיקת מסלולים, metadata ותוכנית חזרה לאחור. כאשר כמה מקורות יכולים לפרוס לאותו יעד, חייבים לזהות אותם, לאחד את קו הבסיס ולחסום פריסה ממקור מיושן שעלולה למחוק יכולות שכבר אושרו.
requirements.acceptance_check: A release cannot pass without live URL, route, status, metadata and rollback evidence. If multiple deploy sources share a destination, the chosen source must contain the complete approved baseline and a stale-source overwrite test must be blocked. Visual evidence from a release that was later replaced is invalid.

requirements.statement: Authenticated administrator searches persist as internal tests even without public analytics consent.
requirements.acceptance_check: Authenticated administrator searches persist as internal tests even without public analytics consent.
evidence: Focused tests passed 18/18: authenticated no-consent searches select internal mode and persist in the detailed demand store.

requirements.statement: Internal tests never increase public demand, unique-session or zero-result totals.
requirements.acceptance_check: Internal tests never increase public demand, unique-session or zero-result totals.
evidence: Database report test proves one public row and one internal row produce total=1, internalTotal=1, one public recent row and one internal recent row.

requirements.statement: Search intelligence exposes actionable rows and a direct path into the editing workflow.
requirements.acceptance_check: Search intelligence exposes actionable rows and a direct path into the editing workflow.
evidence: The admin studio exposes private editor URL, future public URL, locale, indexing gate, sitemap promise, collision error, scheduling, version history and direct public opening after publication.

requirements.statement: Vacation, events, spa and hourly search families retain detailed event coverage.
requirements.acceptance_check: Vacation, events, spa and hourly search families retain detailed event coverage.
evidence: Source coverage and the 658/658 full suite confirm vacation, events, spa and hourly result families retain trackSearchResults.

requirements.statement: Draft, review, published and scheduled search pages use an explicit multilingual URL and indexing lifecycle.
requirements.acceptance_check: Drafts have only a private admin identity; publication requires a unique world-scoped ASCII URL, indexing approval, live resolver eligibility and sitemap inclusion; untranslated editions are not advertised.
evidence: URL policy tests and server guards verify private draft identity, world-scoped ASCII public paths, locale prefixes, indexing-required publication, collision checks and sitemap eligibility.

requirements.statement: Editing a new draft never removes or mutates the currently published edition.
requirements.acceptance_check: Publications persist in a separate immutable live snapshot store; draft and review saves leave that snapshot intact, while archive removes it.
evidence: SQLite lifecycle test publishes a live snapshot, saves a new draft without changing that snapshot, and removes the publication only on archive.

requirements.statement: Build a scalable multilingual sitemap architecture for the new VII site, including correct pagination for a large place inventory.
requirements.acceptance_check: The public sitemap is an index split by content family and deterministic 10000-URL pages; every allowed locale URL is separately listed with reciprocal hreflang; invalid and empty pages return 404.
evidence: Build passed; sitemap routes are /sitemap.xml and /sitemaps/:section/:page; tests verify 10001 URLs split 10000+1, four locale URL entries, reciprocal hreflang, XML escaping, bounded images, and both production-host and staging-host behavior.

requirements.statement: Only approved public indexable pages may enter the sitemap, and published search pages must appear automatically.
requirements.acceptance_check: Catalog entries respect indexable flags, search opportunity entries come only from publishedOpportunityPaths, and accurate publication lastmod is used only when known.
evidence: Inventory filters catalog entries by indexability and builds managed pages exclusively from publishedOpportunityPaths; full suite passed 664/664.

requirements.statement: Expose truthful sitemap health and scale inside the growth administration center.
requirements.acceptance_check: Authenticated sitemap status reports total URLs, child files, languages and per-section counts, and the growth center does not mistake an index for a broken urlset.
evidence: Added authenticated /api/admin/sitemap and updated /admin/growth to show total public URLs and child sitemap files; TypeScript and production build passed.

Focused integration suite passed 18/18: authenticated no-consent admin tests retain internal mode, non-admin events discard, public totals exclude internal rows, recent public/internal inventories and direct opportunity links are present. TypeScript passed.
findings: Confirmed two interacting root mechanisms: client consent short-circuit prevented admin classification, while aggregate reporting deliberately excluded internal events and exposed no internal inventory.
